metadata.description: Multi-model brainstorming skills for Claude Code. Run Codex CLI and a Gemini model (via Antigravity's `agy` CLI) individually, both in parallel, or as a stateful multi-round debate against your real codebase, then synthesize findings with Claude's own review for high-confidence, grounded critiques.
